info.name: Spring AI Agentic Chatbot — Complete HTTP Coverage
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Spring AI Agentic Chatbot.

Covers every HTTP status code produced by AuthController, ChatController, and GlobalExceptionHandler.

Base URL: http://localhost:8080

Quick start:
1. Start the app:  mvn spring-boot:run  (set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var first)
2. Run folder '0 — Setup' first to populate the {{accessToken}} and {{refreshToken}} variables.
3. Then run any other folder in order.

Demo credentials (seeded at startup):
  admin / Admin@1234  →  ROLE_ADMIN + ROLE_USER
  user  / User@1234   →  ROLE_USER

2 — ↗️ 3xx Redirects
item.description:
Tests for 301 and 302 redirects.

IMPORTANT: Disable 'Automatically follow redirects' in Postman Settings BEFORE running this folder, otherwise Postman follows the redirect and you see 200 instead of 301/302.

Settings → General → Request → turn OFF 'Automatically follow redirects'

item.name: 3 — ⚠️ 4xx Client Errors
item.description: All client-error scenarios. Most do not require a JWT token (validation happens before auth for public endpoints, or security returns 401 before the controller is reached).

item.name: 400 — Register: password shorter than 8 chars (@Size validation)
400 — Chat: blank message (@NotBlank validation) — needs token
400 — Chat: message longer than 4000 chars (@Size validation)

body.raw: { this is not valid json at all }

item.name: 401 — Refresh: access token used instead of refresh token

exec: pm.test('error.detail mentions not a refresh token', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.detail.toLowerCase()).to.include('not a refresh token'));

item.name: 403 Forbidden — ROLE_USER tries to access ADMIN-only /actuator/env
405 Method Not Allowed — PUT on /api/chat (POST-only endpoint)
415 Unsupported Media Type — POST /api/chat without Content-Type header
415 Unsupported Media Type — Content-Type: text/plain instead of application/json
4 — 🔥 5xx Server Errors
item.description:
Server-error scenarios. Most 5xx errors are triggered by upstream AI issues.

Notes:
• 500/502/503/504 are hard to trigger reliably without a real Anthropic API error.
• Use the 'invalid API key' trick below to force a 502 immediately.
• 503/504 require stopping the AI service or setting a very short timeout.

item.name: 500 Internal Server Error — valid request but unexpected server failure

exec: pm.test('Status is 200 (good key) or 500/502 (bad key)', () => pm.expect([200, 500, 502]).to.include(status));

item.name: 502 Bad Gateway — force by setting ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=invalid in app.yml then restart

exec: pm.test('Status is 502 (if API key is invalid) or 200 (if valid)', () => pm.expect([200, 401, 502]).to.include(status));
pm.test('Retry-After not required for 502', () => console.log('502 confirmed — upstream API error'));

item.name: 503 Service Unavailable — stop the app and send this request
504 Gateway Timeout — send an enormous prompt to push AI response time

exec: pm.test('Status is 200 (fast model) or 504 (timed out)', () => pm.expect([200, 504]).to.include(status));

item.name: 429 Too Many Requests — rapid fire (run 10x quickly to trigger rate limit)

exec: console.log('⚠️ Rate limited — wait 60s before retrying');
